questions.stem: A mass is given as $5.4\,\text{kg}$ correct to $1$ decimal place. What is the upper bound?
questions.explanation: Rounded to $1$ d.p., the upper bound is $5.45\,\text{kg}$. Values from $5.35$ up to (but not including) $5.45$ would round to $5.4$.

questions.stem: A length is $12\,\text{cm}$ correct to the nearest centimetre. What is the lower bound?
questions.explanation: Rounded to the nearest $1\,\text{cm}$, the lower bound is $11.5\,\text{cm}$. Any value from $11.5$ up to $12.5$ rounds to $12$.
